source: farm/census/manifest.jsonl, the 147 pairs git will merge
hop_semantics: k edges, after fixing an off-by-one in farm.identity.reaches; see tests/test_reaches_hop_budget.py

reproducibility.note: every lane commit and every merge rebuilt from scratch in a fresh clone and matched the manifest exactly

ce006_shape_strict.definition: a one-edge directed chain between the two lanes' changed definitions, and a test body in the merged tree naming a changed definition on each side

off_by_one_inflation.note: how much the previous hop semantics inflated the linked count on these 147 pairs. results/census_resolved.json's link_found (503 of 652) carries the same inflation and has not been recomputed.

not_claimed: That a chain means a failure. It means the two lanes touch related code.
That a test naming a definition would catch a mismatch. In a mature library a test naming a changed public function is close to automatic; 67 is an upper bound on candidates, not a count of failures.
